Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 2
Reason for Mistake: The Planner prematurely adopted the imprecise label “Princess Mary of Hanover” from a less authoritative snippet and repeated it, instead of the correct styling “Princess Mary of Great Britain.” This reflects insufficient source validation and could misidentify the individual (since “Princess Mary of Hanover” is a different 19th‑century princess), even though the Planner later parenthetically equated her with Mary, Princess of Great Britain.
